verdicts.rationale: Repro confirmed: count(exact=true)=2, count(exact:false)=1 for is_empty filter on keyword-indexed field. Scroll ground truth confirms 2 points. Source code analysis reveals no specialized cardinality estimator for is_empty condition on keyword indexes; the estimation falls back to a coarse heuristic (observed 50% scaling). This is a genuine estimator bug: the approximate path returns systematically inaccurate results for this condition class, violating the expectation that approximate counts stay within reasonable tolerance of exact counts for simple indexed conditions.
